The '''Coruscant Customs Bureau building''' was a imposing building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that served as base of operations for the [[Coruscant Customs Bureau]]. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] visited the building in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to obtain information on recently arrived [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]].
